nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_51
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Move the trace forward slightly. This allows detecting walls at sharper (closer to perpendicular) angles.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_795
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If we\'re already wall running, determine if the surface hit by this trace is within the desired angle limits. If it is not within limits, we end the wall run. If we are not yet wall running, continue recording information about the wall.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_782
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: The corner\'s angle is outside our limits - stop the wall run and prevent starting a new one for a short time.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_4078
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Determine if the surface hit by this trace is within the desired angle limits.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_756
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Perform a backup trace if the initial secondary trace detected a corner that was outside the desired limits. This backup trace acts as a failsafe to protect against small gaps/cracks/lips in the wall\'s geometry. To identify if the first trace hit a small gap that should be ignored, we perform this trace a small distance in front of the first one. If this trace finds a surface that has an appropriate angle, we throw out the result of the first trace. If this one also detects a surface with too sharp of an angle (or if it doesn\'t detect a surface at all), we proceed with ending the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3707
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If we are already running on a wall, check the difference in angle between the Primary trace and this one. If it\'s too sharp of a corner, we may need to end the wall run. However, before doing so, we will perform a backup trace to be sure.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_291
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the angle is within limits, record the normal as the SecondaryTraceNormal, then add it to (and normalize) the AverageWallNormal. This average is the combined normal of the two traces that will control the direction of the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3703
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the angle is within limits or we have not yet started a wall run, record the normal as the SecondaryTraceNormal, then add it to (and normalize) the AverageWallNormal. This average is the combined normal of the two traces that will control the direction of the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_431
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If a hit was detected, make sure the hit wall is eligible for wall running. If there was no hit or  the wall is not eligible, we continue with the result of the initial secondary trace - the angle was too sharp, therefore we end the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3664
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If a hit was detected, make sure the hit wall is eligible for wall running. If the wall is not eligible, do nothing - when/if the player reaches this wall, it will be detected by the primary trace and then the wall run will end.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_26
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Find how much space is between the wall and the character\'s capsule. We find the distance between the start and impact locations of the trace, then subtract the character\'s capsule radius. This is later used in the HugWall function.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_1
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If a hit was detected, make sure the hit wall is eligible for wall running. If the wall is not eligible, do nothing - when/if the player reaches this wall, it will be detected by the primary trace and then the wall run will end.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_430
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If a hit was detected, make sure the hit wall is eligible for wall running.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_303
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If we aren\'t already running on a wall, check if there is enough vertical space on the wall to support wall running. If so, begin the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_235
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Record the normal as the SecondaryTraceNormal, then add it to (and normalize) the AverageWallNormal, which is now the average surface normal of the two traces that will control the direction of the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_13
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Backup / Corner trace - If the Secondary trace did not detect a surface, this trace checks for the possibility of an extremely sharp outside corner (~90 degrees). To detect sharp corners, the trace starts slightly past where the corner would be, then traces sharply backwards.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_211
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Secondary trace - Looks for a wall a short distance in front of the player to identify any upcoming turns/corners. The positions of this trace are based on information gathered from the previous trace - it uses the impact point and wall normal from the previous trace to start a short distance forward and away from the wall, then traces in the reverse direction of that wall\'s normal (towards the wall). The end position is moved slightly forward to better detect inside corners.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_8
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If no eligible hit was detected and the character is currently wall running, it means the player has lost contact with the wall (most likely from running off the edge). Stop the wall run immediately.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_7
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Record the impact normal as the PrimaryTraceNormal and as the AverageWallNormal, the latter of which may be modified in future steps. We also record the location of the wall for future reference.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_5
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Primary trace - look for a wall to the left or right of the character (depending on which side was provided when the function was called). The trace begins at the character\'s location and ends a short distance to the character\'s left or right.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_98
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Trace length is based on the character\'s capsule size in order to support differently sized characters

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Modify the direction of the trace depending on which side has been provided

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_14
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Perform a longer trace if we\'re already running on a wall to better detect corners
